name: codebase-guide
description: Writes a visual, single-file HTML onboarding guide for the repo in the working directory: what it does, how it is built and where everything lives. Styled by a bundled design system (Meridian by default) and exported to one offline file.

design_system.title: Design system
design_system.description: Design system the guide is built on; builtin uses the skill's own template. CODEBASE_GUIDE_DESIGN_SYSTEM overrides it for one shell.
